scripts.check:all: bun run check:backend && bun run check:frontend
scripts.typecheck:all: bun run typecheck:backend && bun run typecheck:frontend
scripts.build:backend: echo 'Backend builds at runtime with Bun' && exit 0
scripts.audit:frontend: cd frontend && bun audit || echo 'Frontend audit failed'
scripts.audit:sdk: cd sdk/typescript && bun audit || echo 'SDK audit failed'
scripts.audit:all: bun run audit:backend && bun run audit:frontend && bun run audit:sdk
scripts.security:trivy:docker: bash -lc "docker run --rm -v "$(pwd)":/project aquasecurity/trivy:latest fs --severity CRITICAL,HIGH,MEDIUM --format sarif -o trivy-fs-results.sarif /project"
scripts.build:all: bun run build:backend && bun run build:sdk && bun run build:frontend
scripts.ci-local: bun run check:all && bun run typecheck:all && bun run test && bun run build:all
scripts.push:partial: git commit --allow-empty -m "chore: partial push [run-partial]" && git push && git reset --soft HEAD~1

frontend/src/components/**/*.{tsx,jsx}: bash -c 'if [[ "$0" != *"src/components/ui/"* ]]; then cd frontend && biome format --write "${0#frontend/}" && biome check --fix "${0#frontend/}"; fi'
frontend/src/**/*.{ts,tsx,js,jsx}: bash -c 'if [[ "$0" != *"src/components/ui/"* ]]; then cd frontend && biome format --write "${0#frontend/}" && biome check --fix "${0#frontend/}"; fi'
